factor_id: # Market factors a question can be relevant to (factors.py), linked through seeds/entity_factors.csv. series = where prices.py reads its daily level (yahoo:<symbol> close, fred:<series id>; blank = not measured); units = how a move is measured: % = log return x 100, bp = change in the level (FRED spreads and yields are in percent, x 100). factor_betas.py measures each question's sensitivity in these units.
